sources.note: Its stress survey (ch. 5: traces of penultimate stress in Ma'ya, Moor, Yerisiam; penultimate default cited for Buli, Sawai, Taba, Ambai, Wandamen, Waropen, Warembori) never mentions Tandia. Tandia data come solely from Kijne n.d.(a), an unpublished KITLV notebook (D Or. 421, inv. 33); Kamholz repeatedly notes 'no data for Tandia'. Tandia is placed as a primary branch of Proto-SHWNG (p. 140).
